kept.name: e:us-skyline
kept.depicts: Four dark-blue skyscrapers dotted with yellow and cyan lit windows, one topped by a spire and another by a cyan rooftop tank.

kept.name: e:us-pid1
kept.depicts: A tall grey observation tower with two catwalks, yellow and cyan windows, and a glowing green beacon at its summit.
A grey horizontal pipe manifold fitted with four square sight-glass ports glowing cyan and green.

kept.name: e:us-crontower
kept.depicts: A slender grey clock tower with a white clock face, black hands, three yellow windows, and a red beacon on top.

kept.name: e:us-socket
kept.depicts: A grey two-prong plug hovering beside a dark-grey two-hole receptacle.
A cyan water-tower tank with a pale-cyan level window resting on a cross-braced grey steel trestle.

kept.name: e:us-signal
kept.depicts: A tall grey flagpole flying a waving two-tone red pennant.

kept.name: e:us-mailbox
kept.depicts: A blue curbside mailbox on a grey post with a raised red flag and a black mail slot.

kept.name: e:us-fork
kept.depicts: A grey signpost splitting into two staggered green-and-white street-name blades.

kept.name: e:us-callbox
kept.depicts: A blue emergency callbox on a dark base with a cyan indicator screen and a teal beacon light on top.

kept.name: e:us-container
kept.depicts: A corrugated green shipping container with a grey-framed door panel on the right.
A red fire hydrant with bright-red side nozzles and cap on a dark-grey base.

kept.name: e:us-meter
kept.depicts: A square grey parking-style meter on a post with a black face and a glowing green rectangular readout.

kept.name: c:userspace:core
kept.depicts: A small red horned creature with yellow eyes and a trailing red tail, accompanied by a floating yellow square.

rework.name: e:us-pipe
rework.depicts: An overhead grey horizontal conduit with two vertical drop-legs and two cyan flow indicators.
rework.problem: ART-STYLE rule 7: under 8 px and floating; give it supports

rework.name: e:us-tty
rework.depicts: A grey-bezeled CRT monitor showing green text bars and a bright green block cursor on a black screen.
rework.problem: ART-STYLE rule 6: floating screen; give it a terminal body/stand

rework.name: e:us-firewall
rework.depicts: A low red-brick wall topped by four flickering yellow and red flames.

deleted.name: e:us-tower
deleted.depicts: A narrow blue high-rise block with lit yellow and cyan office windows, appearing in three height variants.
deleted.reason: Visually and conceptually redundant with the Process Skyline anchor.

deleted.name: e:us-sign
deleted.depicts: A black horizontal marquee bordered in magenta displaying glowing pink pixel text reading JOURNAL.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 2: a word in a box ("UDEV")

deleted.name: e:us-pidplate
deleted.depicts: A dark-blue rectangular license plate displaying white pixel numerals reading 564.
deleted.reason: ART-STYLE rule 2: big number plate; text carries the whole prop

deleted.name: e:us-cabinet
deleted.depicts: A grey three-drawer filing cabinet with dark-grey drawer fronts and yellow label strips.
deleted.reason: Generic filing cabinet filler that overlaps with the Dot-A Archive in libraries.

deleted.name: e:us-crate
deleted.depicts: A brown shipping crate strapped with a yellow band and stamped with a white-bordered grey label.
deleted.reason: Generic shipping crate that overlaps with Dot-C Crates in the libraries layer.

deleted.name: e:us-busbar
deleted.depicts: A horizontal grey-framed conduit carrying two dark-blue and teal rails with yellow and cyan pulse segments.
deleted.reason: Generic horizontal conduit visually similar to Unix Pipe.

deleted.name: e:us-journal
deleted.depicts: A grey corner bracket beside four staggered horizontal log bars alternating red and dark grey.
deleted.reason: Duplicates the systemd journal concept already represented by Journal Marquee.

deleted.name: e:us-padlock
deleted.depicts: A bright yellow rectangular padlock with a grey shackle and a vertical black keyhole.
deleted.reason: Generic padlock visual that overlaps with Sleeping Padlock in kernel and Trust Anchor in internet.

deleted.name: e:us-antenna
deleted.depicts: A grey tripod mast topped by a blinking red beacon.
deleted.reason: Generic rooftop antenna filler; network beacons are better covered in the internet layer.

deleted.depicts: A cyan-framed rooftop billboard on two grey legs displaying a magenta bar above a yellow bar.
deleted.reason: Generic rooftop billboard for a minor concept (MOTD).

deleted.depicts: A circular grey iron manhole cover with a dark-grey rim and a black slot across the center.
deleted.reason: Overlaps with Syscall Booth for kernel entry from userspace.

deleted.name: e:us-vent
deleted.depicts: A dark-grey rectangular wall vent with three horizontal light-grey louver slats.
deleted.reason: Generic architectural vent filler; stdout/stderr is better represented by Stdout Hydrant.
